newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Aeroflot sees $400 mln Boeing deal signing in Apr.
newsitem.headline: Aeroflot sees $400 mln Boeing deal signing in Apr.

text.p: Russia's Aeroflot -Russian International Airlines plans to sign a final agreement with U.S. plane-maker Boeing in April to purchase 10 jets worth about $400 million, the company said on Thursday.
Aeroflot will buy 10 Boeing 737-400 passenger jets for delivery in 1998-1999, a spokesman said. The companies signed a memorandum of agreement on the deal last September.
"We have almost finished talks on technical specifications of the aircraft and plan to sign a final agreement at the end of April," the spokesman said.
The 737-400s will replace short-range Tupolev Tu-134 jets, which Aeroflot operates on its domestic and international routes, he said.
Aeroflot has 12 Tu-134s in its fleet of 115 aircraft.
The spokesman said the move would be Aeroflot's first major purchase made without Russian government financial guarantees.
